items.statement: Remote monitoring with hub titration increases the proportion of women with blood pressure below 140 over 90 at the six-week check from about 60 percent to about 75 percent.
items.rationale: Planning values follow the retrieved self-management trial (c3); feasible within 300 monitors.
items.risks: Missing six-week readings; contamination through midwives.

items.statement: Inclusive delivery (loan phones, paper diaries and interpreter calls) keeps uptake among women needing an interpreter within 10 percentage points of other women.
items.rationale: Addresses the uptake gap in c4.

summary: h1 primary; h2 an equity process hypothesis.
